newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra says asthma drug U.S. approval around corner.
newsitem.headline: Astra says asthma drug U.S. approval around corner.

text.p: Swedish drug company Astra spokesman Staffan Ternby said on Friday the group expected approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for its asthma treatment, the Pulmicort Turbuhaler.

"Because we are constantly being asked questions about when Pulmicort will be approved, we must guess. Judging from the questions we receive from the FDA, they are dealing with marginal issues," Ternby told Reuters.
"This makes us feel that an approval could be around the corner," he said.
Ternby had been in the United States meeting investors and he had the impression they had a positive view on the company. This may explain the upturn in the share in recent days.
On Thursday Astra jumped 8.5 crowns to 323.5 and at 1115 GMT on Friday it was trading at 325.5, up two.

"I think U.S. investors have a positive view on the share and this could affect the share price positively. I don't think speculation about when the Pulmicort Turbuhaler will be approved is fuelling the gains," he said.
"We have been guessing about the date of the approval for a while now," he added.
